title: Smarter and more informative bolus&QW calc result in regards to TT and BG
body:
If bolus calculator setting in wear is configured with TT always enabled and a QW is setup with TT always enabled, bolus calc result in treatments show TT box ticked off although there isn't a TT active. This can be confusing when looking at result and lead to think there was an active TT when bolus calc was run.

1)  Is it possible to only tick off TT checkbox in bolus/QW calc result if there is an active TT when QW and bolus calc in wear is used, when TT correction is always enabled in QW and wear bolus calc setting?

2) Also suggest moving currentBG to the right of BG checkbox and introducing currentTT value to the right of TT checkbox if a TT is active when calc is performed.

Both these will make bolus calc result in treatments more accurate and informative :)

Illustration:
![image](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/assets/114103483/db04912e-7dab-4d00-ab15-5fdb35efc390)
